title: V4 质量辅助选股 Q0/Q1 审计
primary_question: 基本面质量是否适合作为 V4 个股腿的候选压缩/同分打破辅助，而不是硬过滤或主排序？
primary_variable: read-only Q0 PIT quality contract audit + Q1 trade quality attribution
fixed_assumptions: baseline_V10_1 fixed; no strategy or baseline mutation
quality uses public.pit_stock_fundamental_quality only with ann_date <= signal_date
quality is evaluated as an auxiliary selector, not as a standalone signal
key_findings: Quality table is usable for PIT research when enforcing ann_date <= signal_date.
Main-window coverage is 288/335 lots, 85.97%; 2026 coverage is 34/44 lots, 77.27%.
q4_high quality bucket has strongest profile: avg_return 11.96%, median_return 2.41%, win_rate 58.54%.
Loss TOP30 is concentrated away from q4_high: q4 appears only once in loss TOP30.
Low/mid quality buckets still contain strong winners, so hard low-quality veto is not safe.

decision.reason: Q0/Q1 supports quality as auxiliary selector, but not as hard filter or main ranking factor; next step should be minimal Q2 AB under near-tie/candidate-crowding only.

next_actions: Design Q2 AB: B0 vs Q_TIEBREAK vs Q_CROWDED_RERANK with stock V4 fixed.
Do not test hard low-quality veto before proving strong-winner miss risk is controlled.
Use three-window validation only if Q2 main-window behavior is interpretable.

auto_summary.headline: V4 质量辅助选股 Q0/Q1 审计
auto_summary.conclusion_draft: Q0/Q1 支持继续推进质量辅助选股，但只建议作为候选拥挤或趋势分接近时的二级选择器，不建议做低质量硬过滤。
facts: 质量表 pit_stock_fundamental_quality 可在 ann_date <= signal_date 约束下做 PIT 研究。
q4_high 分组胜率 58.54%，中位收益 2.41%，表现最稳。
低/中质量组仍有强趋势大赢家，硬过滤风险较高。
risks: 尚未进行 Q2 真实 AB，不能作为 baseline 升级依据。
next_actions: 设计 Q2 AB：B0 vs Q_TIEBREAK vs Q_CROWDED_RERANK。
